game_title: Safe Get Scout – Snowline Trail Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail, the trail at the snowline: the sherpa guide must handle avalanches while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Safe Get Scout: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors.
theme: Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail: the trail at the snowline
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowline Trail, repeat each round: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the safe_lookups value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the rescue sled using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The rescue sled reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the rescue sled is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 6 (applied tier): Safe Get Scout
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Safe Get Scout' (Week 8 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Snowline Trail'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how safe_lookups changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against avalanches in Snowline Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The rescue sled reached with actions_used <= 21.
